theorem mvcc.cutInv_rev {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hl : List.length log + 1 < 2 ^ 63)
    (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hcsl : ∀ (c : List mvcc.Change), c ∈ log → c.length < 2 ^ 63) (hwf :
    mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (hne : log ≠ []) (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) (hK : ∀ (e₁ : mvcc.Ev), e₁ ∈
    mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) cs → ∀ (e₂ : mvcc.Ev), e₂ ∈ mvcc.evsOf log ++
    mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) cs → e₁.key = e₂.key → e₁.rev.lt e₂.rev → K e₁.rev = true → K
    e₂.rev = true) {idx0 : mvcc.IndexM} (h0 : mvcc.CutInv K (mvcc.evsOf log) idx0) (i : Nat) : i ≤
    cs.length → mvcc.CutInv K (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs))
    (List.foldl mvcc.idxRestoreEnt idx0 (List.filter (fun e => K e.rev) (List.filterMap (fun j =>
    Option.map (fun kv => { rev := { main := W64 ↑(List.length log), sub := W64 ↑j }, tomb :=
    (cs.getD j (mvcc.Change.del [])).isDel, kv := kv }) (mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑(List.length log))
    (mvcc.stateAfter log) cs j)) (List.range i))))

theorem mvcc.lastEmpty_false_at_del {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hl : List.length log +
    1 < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hcsl : ∀ (c : List mvcc.Change), c ∈ log → c.length < 2
    ^ 63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (hne : log ≠ []) {i : Nat} (hi : i < cs.length) {k :
    GoString} (hc : cs[i] = mvcc.Change.del k) : mvcc.kiLastEmpty (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log ++
    mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs)) k) = false

theorem mvcc.entsCutAt_full (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : mvcc.entsCutAt L c (mvcc.logEnts L 0
    (List.length L))

theorem mvcc.cutInv_logEnts (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) (rl : List (List mvcc.Change)) : rl.length < 2 ^
    63 → (∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ rl → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) → mvcc.LogWf' rl.reverse → (∀ (e₁
    : mvcc.Ev), e₁ ∈ mvcc.evsOf rl.reverse → ∀ (e₂ : mvcc.Ev), e₂ ∈ mvcc.evsOf rl.reverse → e₁.key =
    e₂.key → e₁.rev.lt e₂.rev → K e₁.rev = true → K e₂.rev = true) → mvcc.CutInv K (mvcc.evsOf
    rl.reverse) (mvcc.idxRestore (List.filter (fun e => K e.rev) (mvcc.logEnts rl.reverse 0
    rl.reverse.length)))

def mvcc.RevBefore (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (gi j : Nat) (r : mvcc.Rev) : Prop :=
  ∃ i' j',
    (i' < gi ∨ i' = gi ∧ j' < j) ∧
      i' < ki.gens.length ∧ j' < (ki.gens.getD i' mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length ∧ r = mvcc.revAt ki i' j'

theorem mvcc.kiCutAt_last_kiPut {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hne : ki.gens ≠ []) (rev : mvcc.Rev) :
    mvcc.kiCutAt (ki.gens.length - 1) (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length (mvcc.kiPut ki
    rev) = { modified := rev, gens :=
        [mvcc.genDrop (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length
            (mvcc.genPut (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) rev)] }

theorem mvcc.kiApply_length {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hne : ki.gens ≠ []) {ev : mvcc.Ev} (hch :
    mvcc.EvChanges ki ev) : ki.gens.length ≤ (mvcc.kiApply ki ev).gens.length

theorem mvcc.kiCompact_empty_of_dropped {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (hall :
    ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki → sint.Z r.main ≤ sint.Z c) (hav : mvcc.kiAvail c ki =
    none) : mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) = true

theorem mvcc.idxRestoreEnt_sorted {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) (e :
    mvcc.KvEnt) : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess (mvcc.idxRestoreEnt idx e)

def mvcc.EvChanges (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (ev : mvcc.Ev) : Prop :=
  ev.tomb = true → mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki = false

theorem mvcc.keyAt_change {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hl : List.length log + 1 < 2 ^
    63) (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hcsl : ∀ (c : List mvcc.Change), c ∈ log → c.length < 2 ^ 63)
    (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (k : GoString) {i : Nat} (hi : i ≤ cs.length) : mvcc.KiAbove
    (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs)) k) { main :=
    W64 ↑(List.length log), sub := W64 0 } ∧ mvcc.KvMatch (log ++ [cs]) (mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey
    (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i cs)) k) (W64 ↑(List.length
    log))) (mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length log)) (mvcc.stateAfter log)
    (List.take i cs)))

theorem mvcc.sublist_eq_filter_rev {l' l : List mvcc.KvEnt} (hs : l'.Sublist l) (hp : List.Pairwise
    (fun a b => a.rev ≠ b.rev) l) : List.filter (fun e => decide (∃ e', e' ∈ l' ∧ e'.rev = e.rev)) l
    = l'

theorem mvcc.idxRestore_cut (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' L)
    (hb : mvcc.LogB L) (h0 : -1 ≤ c) (hc : c < ↑(List.length L)) (hcut : mvcc.entsCutAt L c ents) :
    mvcc.IdxCRepN c (mvcc.evsOf L) (mvcc.idxRestore ents)

theorem mvcc.genDrop_genPut_last (g : mvcc.Gen) (rev : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.genDrop g.revs.length
    (mvcc.genPut g rev) = { ver := g.ver + W64 1, created := if g.revs = [] then rev.main else
    g.created, revs := [rev] }

theorem mvcc.logEnts_of_ev {L : mvcc.Log} {e : mvcc.Ev} (he : e ∈ mvcc.evsOf L) : ∃ ent, ent ∈
    mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L) ∧ ent.rev = e.rev ∧ ent.kv.key = e.key ∧ ent.tomb = e.tomb

theorem mvcc.idxGet_idxRestoreEnt {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) (e :
    mvcc.KvEnt) (k : GoString) : mvcc.idxGet (mvcc.idxRestoreEnt idx e) k = if e.kv.key = k then
    mvcc.restoreO e (mvcc.idxGet idx k) else mvcc.idxGet idx k

theorem mvcc.revAt_def (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (gi j : Nat) : mvcc.revAt ki gi j = (ki.gens.getD gi
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.getD j mvcc.Rev.zero

theorem mvcc.cutInv_step {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hl : List.length log + 1 < 2 ^
    63) (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hcsl : ∀ (c : List mvcc.Change), c ∈ log → c.length < 2 ^ 63)
    (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (hne : log ≠ []) {i : Nat} (hi : i < cs.length) {kv : EtcdKv}
    (hkv : mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑(List.length log)) (mvcc.stateAfter log) cs i = some kv) (K :
    mvcc.Rev → Bool) (hK : ∀ (e₁ : mvcc.Ev), e₁ ∈ mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log)
    (List.take (i + 1) cs) → ∀ (e₂ : mvcc.Ev), e₂ ∈ mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length
    log) (List.take (i + 1) cs) → e₁.key = e₂.key → e₁.rev.lt e₂.rev → K e₁.rev = true → K e₂.rev =
    true) {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.CutInv K (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log)
    (List.take i cs)) idx) : mvcc.CutInv K (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log)
    (List.take (i + 1) cs)) (if K { main := W64 ↑(List.length log), sub := W64 ↑i } = true then
    mvcc.idxRestoreEnt idx { rev := { main := W64 ↑(List.length log), sub := W64 ↑i }, tomb :=
    cs[i].isDel, kv := kv } else idx)

def mvcc.CutInv (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (idx : mvcc.IndexM) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx ∧ ∀ (k : GoString), mvcc.KeyCut K (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k) (mvcc.idxGet idx k)

theorem mvcc.IdxCRepN_of_cutInv (L : mvcc.Log) (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (h :
    mvcc.CutInv K (mvcc.evsOf L) idx) (c : Int) (h0 : -1 ≤ c) (hc : c < 2 ^ 63) (hdrop : ∀ (e :
    mvcc.Ev), e ∈ mvcc.evsOf L → K e.rev = false → sint.Z e.rev.main ≤ c ∧ ¬mvcc.keepAt L c e.rev) :
    mvcc.IdxCRepN c (mvcc.evsOf L) idx

theorem mvcc.kiApply_revAt {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hne : ki.gens ≠ []) {ev : mvcc.Ev} (hch :
    mvcc.EvChanges ki ev) {i j : Nat} (hi : i < ki.gens.length) (hj : j < (ki.gens.getD i
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length) : j < ((mvcc.kiApply ki ev).gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length
    ∧ mvcc.revAt (mvcc.kiApply ki ev) i j = mvcc.revAt ki i j

theorem mvcc.idxRestore_eq_foldl (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : mvcc.idxRestore ents = List.foldl
    mvcc.idxRestoreEnt [] ents

theorem mvcc.keyCut_kept_new (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) {ev :
    mvcc.Ev} (hch : mvcc.EvChanges ki ev) (hK : K ev.rev = true) (hnone : ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈
    mvcc.kiRevs ki → K r = false) {R : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hR : mvcc.kiNorm R = mvcc.kiNorm
    (mvcc.kiCutAt (ki.gens.length - 1) (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length (mvcc.kiApply
    ki ev))) : mvcc.KeyCut K (mvcc.kiApply ki ev) (some R)

theorem mvcc.cutLe_of_dropped {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) {gi j : Nat} (hgi
    : gi < ki.gens.length) (hj : j < (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length) (hbef : ∀ (r :
    mvcc.Rev), mvcc.RevBefore ki gi j r → sint.Z r.main ≤ sint.Z c ∧ mvcc.kiAvail c ki ≠ some r) :
    mvcc.CutLe c ki gi j

theorem mvcc.cutInv_nil (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) : mvcc.CutInv K [] []

theorem mvcc.kiApply_gens_getD {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hne : ki.gens ≠ []) {ev : mvcc.Ev} (hch :
    mvcc.EvChanges ki ev) {i : Nat} (hi : i < ki.gens.length) : (mvcc.kiApply ki ev).gens.getD i
    mvcc.Gen.empty = if i + 1 < ki.gens.length then ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty else mvcc.genPut
    (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty) ev.rev

theorem mvcc.revAt_mem {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {i j : Nat} (hi : i < ki.gens.length) (hj : j <
    (ki.gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length) : mvcc.revAt ki i j ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki

def mvcc.KeyCut (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (o : Option mvcc.KeyIndex) : Prop :=
  (o = none ∧ ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki → K r = false) ∨
    ∃ gi j,
      gi < ki.gens.length ∧
        j < (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length ∧
          K (mvcc.revAt ki gi j) = true ∧
            (∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), mvcc.RevBefore ki gi j r → K r = false) ∧
              Option.map mvcc.kiNorm o = some (mvcc.kiNorm (mvcc.kiCutAt gi j ki))

def mvcc.revAt (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (gi j : Nat) : mvcc.Rev :=
  (ki.gens.getD gi mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.getD j mvcc.Rev.zero

def mvcc.restoreO (e : mvcc.KvEnt) (o : Option mvcc.KeyIndex) : Option mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  match o with
  | some ki =>
    if e.tomb = true then if mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki = true then some ki else some (mvcc.kiTombstone ki e.rev)
    else some (mvcc.kiPut ki e.rev)
  | none =>
    some (if e.tomb = true then mvcc.kiRestoreTombstone e.rev else mvcc.kiRestore e.kv.createRev e.rev e.kv.version)

theorem mvcc.evsOfRev_take_mem {m : Nat} {cs : List mvcc.Change} {i : Nat} {e : mvcc.Ev} (h : e ∈
    mvcc.evsOfRev m (List.take i cs)) : e ∈ mvcc.evsOfRev m cs

theorem mvcc.logEnts_rev_inj {L : mvcc.Log} (hb : mvcc.LogB L) {e₁ e₂ : mvcc.KvEnt} (h₁ : e₁ ∈
    mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L)) (h₂ : e₂ ∈ mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L)) (h : e₁.rev =
    e₂.rev) : e₁ = e₂

theorem mvcc.kiCutAt_last_kiTombstone {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hne : ki.gens ≠ []) (rev : mvcc.Rev) :
    mvcc.kiCutAt (ki.gens.length - 1) (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length
    (mvcc.kiTombstone ki rev) = { modified := rev, gens :=
        [mvcc.genDrop (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length (mvcc.genPut (ki.gens.getLastD mvcc.Gen.empty) rev),
          mvcc.Gen.empty] }

theorem mvcc.keyCut_kept_old (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) {ev :
    mvcc.Ev} (hch : mvcc.EvChanges ki ev) {X : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h : mvcc.KeyCut K ki (some X)) :
    mvcc.KeyCut K (mvcc.kiApply ki ev) (mvcc.stepO ev (some X))

theorem mvcc.RevBefore.of_kiApply {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hne : ki.gens ≠ []) {ev : mvcc.Ev} (hch :
    mvcc.EvChanges ki ev) {gi j : Nat} (hgi : gi < ki.gens.length) (hj : j ≤ (ki.gens.getD gi
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs.length) {r : mvcc.Rev} (h : mvcc.RevBefore (mvcc.kiApply ki ev) gi j r) :
    mvcc.RevBefore ki gi j r

theorem mvcc.keyCut_dropped (K : mvcc.Rev → Bool) {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) {ev :
    mvcc.Ev} (hch : mvcc.EvChanges ki ev) (hK : K ev.rev = false) {o : Option mvcc.KeyIndex} (hnone
    : ∀ (r : mvcc.Rev), r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki → K r = false) (h : mvcc.KeyCut K ki o) : mvcc.KeyCut K
    (mvcc.kiApply ki ev) o
